scenario_description:
Objective: Use a narrow Harbor Week publicity opening to add visibility for Beacon Lines without changing exhibit logistics or commitments.
Emerging Need: A possible preview-reel tile becomes useful only if public-safe materials and the correct partner contact are available before the edit locks.
Decision Context: The record first shows a planned image review, then a generic publicity channel, material clearance, and finally a same-day intake window tied to Port Crescent.
Consequence: Missing the window merely leaves the reel filled with venue content; shipment, access, and installation plans remain unaffected.

parameter.title: Beacon Lines exterior image review
parameter.description: Check whether existing exterior case images and the public title line are suitable for routine partner-facing publicity. No lender details or packing views to be considered.

parameter.name: Port Crescent Harbor Week Desk
parameter.notes: Maintains the optional Harbor Week preview reel list; submissions are routed through the venue's public-programs coordinator when a project has cleared public copy.

parameter.subject: Beacon Lines exterior image clearance
parameter.body: Registrar okayed use of one exterior case image and the existing public title line for routine partner publicity. No lender names, values, packing details, or conservation notes should be included.

parameter.content: Public Programs is cutting a short Harbor Week preview reel today. They have one open partner-exhibit tile for Beacon Lines if a public-safe image and title arrive before 14:00; otherwise they'll fill it with a dock tour clip. No obligation either way.

parameter.subject: Harbor Week preview reel locked
parameter.body: The 14:00 ingest window has closed and the preview reel is exporting with the dock tour filler. We may have room for a standard August newsletter mention later if Beacon Lines materials are available then.
